cases.name: a-format-and-a-purpose-read-as-acrobat-decides
cases.covers: Each field's format from its format script alone, Acrobat's date and time calls in every wording, other scripts as other, a keystroke script alone as none; a purpose from /EMBD_Metadata /Purpose, one with space around it as none; list and signature fields carry no format.

cases.name: a-create-names-a-purpose-on-every-kind
cases.covers: A text field, a checkbox, a signature field and a push button each take a purpose; left out or null, none.

cases.name: an-update-sets-keeps-and-removes-a-purpose
cases.covers: A purpose is form design alone, on a field in a group the designer may not assign; left out it stays; null takes it away; none to take away is no change; a signature field has one like any other.

cases.name: a-purpose-that-is-none-is-refused
cases.covers: An empty purpose, one with space at either end, one past 256 characters, one with a NUL, a number and an object are refused by an update and a create with InvalidArg; the longest is taken, and any other character is kept.

cases.name: undo-puts-a-purpose-back
cases.covers: Undo puts a purpose back and its undo sets it again; after a later change the undo puts it back by value.

cases.name: an-update-that-expects-a-purpose
cases.covers: expect: { purpose } holds the update to a field that has it: null on full_name is a ChangeConflict, its own purpose applies.

cases.name: a-create-writes-a-date-and-a-time-as-acrobat-does
cases.covers: A text field's date, a text field's time (the keystroke script names the standard time pattern by number) and a dropdown's date are written as the two scripts Acrobat writes, with form design alone; left out or null, none.

cases.name: an-update-sets-replaces-and-removes-a-format
cases.covers: A format is set, kept when left out, replaced by a time, removed by null with both scripts; a dropdown takes one.

cases.name: a-format-owns-the-two-scripts
cases.covers: null removes another format with its keystroke script; with no format, a keystroke script alone stays; a format replaces a keystroke script it didn't write.

cases.name: the-format-a-field-has-changes-nothing
cases.covers: The format a field already has, in Acrobat's older numbered wording, changes nothing; an other format and a date with its own keystroke script stay through a write of something else.

cases.name: a-format-that-is-none-is-refused
cases.covers: Another kind, a pattern of no kind, one whose writing does not read back, one with a part twice, one of the other kind and a bare string are refused by an update and a create with InvalidArg before anything is written; the longest pattern is taken; a date may carry a time.

cases.name: a-format-goes-on-a-text-field-and-a-dropdown-only
cases.covers: A list and a signature field refuse a format and null; a checkbox create refuses one; a format beside actions.format, actions.keystroke or a null keystroke is refused; beside a validate script it goes.

cases.name: a-script-write-changes-the-format
cases.covers: A format read back is the scripts': a date script makes a date, other code makes other, removing it makes none.

cases.name: undo-puts-a-format-back
cases.covers: Undo puts back the older wording a format replaced, and its undo sets the format again; a removed number format comes back whole; after a later change the undo puts a set format back by value.

cases.name: after-a-later-change-the-undo-of-a-format-puts-back-what-it-replaced
cases.covers: A number format and an older wording a format replaced come back as written after a later change to the field.

cases.name: the-undo-of-a-format-leaves-a-script-written-since
cases.covers: A keystroke script written after a format is someone else's work: the undo is skipped and both scripts stay.

cases.name: the-undo-of-a-format-over-a-goto-puts-all-back
cases.covers: With nothing changed since, the undo of a format over a script that goes on to a GoTo puts the script and the GoTo back.

cases.name: the-undo-of-a-format-over-a-goto-after-a-change-puts-nothing-back
cases.covers: After a later change the GoTo can't go back by value, so neither script is touched and the undo is skipped.

cases.name: the-undo-of-a-script-over-a-goto-after-a-change-puts-nothing-back
cases.covers: A script written over such actions follows the same rule.

cases.name: an-update-that-expects-a-format
cases.covers: expect: { format } holds the update to a field that has it: null on plain_one is a ChangeConflict, its own date applies.

cases.name: a-copy-keeps-a-purpose-and-a-format-without-the-script-right
cases.covers: Without doc.forms.script a copy keeps a purpose and a date or time format, written from the pattern, and reports nothing dropped.

cases.name: a-copy-without-the-script-right-leaves-out-what-is-no-date-or-time
cases.covers: An other format is left out and reported; a date's own keystroke script of other code is reported and the copy gets the format's own.

cases.name: a-copy-with-the-script-right-keeps-the-scripts-as-written
cases.covers: With doc.forms.script a copy keeps the older wording and a keystroke script of its own as they are.

cases.name: both-take-form-design
cases.covers: A filler is refused a purpose and a format by an update and a create (Forbidden, doc.forms.modify) and reads both; a designer is refused the same format as a script of her own (doc.forms.script) and may set the format and a purpose.

cases.name: a-designer-writes-a-format-not-its-script
cases.covers: The same format as a script takes doc.forms.script, which a designer lacks; as a format, with a purpose, it is form design.
